summary: tajul-avengers exfiltrates host identity to a hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint
details: The npm package tajul-avengers ships a CLI (bin/index.js) that collects host identity information including os.hostname() and transmits it via fetch() to a hardcoded Google Apps Script web app URL (https://script.google.com/...). Multiple fetch() call sites (lines 135, 151, 236) target this author-controlled endpoint, and the destination is unrelated to any documented purpose of a utility package. The use of a Google Apps Script URL as the collection sink is a common exfiltration pattern that bypasses typical attacker-domain reputation checks. The hardcoded, non-caller-configurable destination combined with host identifier collection matches the credential/host-reconnaissance exfiltration shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
